rule: For each whole-frame p50 and p95, compare the median of three after windows minus the median of three before windows with the larger full within-build range. A positive change beyond that range fails the descriptive noise gate. Retain p99 and maximum separately. This is not an equivalence test.
sequence: three before, then three after; identical fixture, normal speed, 10-second warmup, 60-second sample, manual save and reload outside timing
diagnostics: Detailed optional tracing and per-admission metrics disabled during primary frame windows. No concurrent offline build/test activity.
